summary: Frontend-only verification of Game Platform batch. All 6 requested features passed end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL.

issues: Cosmetic only: 'TOP PILOTS' label wraps to two lines and the ALL-TIME / WEEK tab pair sits slightly cramped against it at 1920x4000 viewport — layout still fully usable.

critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning observed on both /profile and /chat: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Likely a Select/Option component rendering a span inside a native <option>. Not blocking but should be cleaned up.

Multiple background 401s in the console on public pages (/games, /game-builder) — some component fires an authenticated request without gating. Not user-visible but noisy; consider guarding those fetches when user is anonymous.
seed_data_creation: Added one leaderboard entry 'PYTEST_UI' with score 0 to game 'spaceshooter' (both all-time and weekly). Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright tip: /games/play/:gameId keeps a rAF network active — always use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (networkidle times out). Force game-over inside the iframe with page-context evaluate calling gameOver() — verified working for spaceshooter.
